title: Explore Wikipedia Like a Windows XP Desktop
summary: A creative web project that reimagines Wikipedia browsing as a Windows XP desktop experience, featuring classic UI elements like the Start menu, taskbar, and desktop icons for exploring articles.
problem_solved: Makes Wikipedia exploration more engaging and nostalgic by transforming the browsing experience into a familiar Windows XP interface.
why_valuable: Combines retro UI nostalgia with practical utility, making knowledge discovery more fun and accessible through familiar desktop metaphors.
